landing.title: Play and Learn – even with ADHD
landing.subtitle: Visual learning in small steps, with absolutely no time pressure, but plenty of gaming fun. For kids aged 6 to 12.
landing.why.title: Why Baloo?
landing.why.adhd.title: 🧠 ADHD-Friendly
landing.why.adhd.desc: Low-stimulation design with calm colors, clear structures, and no distracting background noises or time limits.
landing.why.visual.title: 🎨 Visual Learning
landing.why.visual.desc: High-quality, interactive graphics (SVGs) make biology and scientific topics tangible and easy to grasp.
landing.why.stars.title: ⭐ Motivating System
landing.why.stars.desc: Children earn stars by solving learning tasks and can use them to unlock fun reward games.
landing.how.title: How Baloo Works
landing.how.step1: 1. Select a topic (e.g., The Eye, The Ear)
landing.parents.title: Especially for Parents & Teachers
landing.parents.desc: Create custom lectures in seconds! Simply upload a PDF document, a photo from a textbook, or type a text description. Our AI (Gemini) automatically generates child-friendly exercises for your child. Keep track of their progress easily.
landing.parents.feature1: Upload custom learning materials (PDF, Image, Text)
